edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner in the Ownable constructor, granting full control to the caller.
The Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
The Ownable constructor consumes msg.sender to set the initial owner.
OnlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner on every transferOwnership call.
transferOwnership reads owner for the modifier check and the OwnershipTransferred event.
newOwner parameter is validated and written into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner.
setTier inherits onlyOwner, whose require compares msg.sender with owner.
_tier parameter flows into the tier state variable.
setTier writes the privileged tier state variable that gates updateRate.
onlyTier modifier reads tier when authorizing updateRate.
onlyTier compares msg.sender against the stored tier address.
newOneTokenInWei parameter flows toward the oneTokenInWei state variable.
updateRate assigns the new price to oneTokenInWei.
The FlatPricingExt constructor initializes oneTokenInWei.
_oneTokenInWei parameter is stored by the constructor.
calculatePrice divides the scaled value by the oneTokenInWei state variable.
value parameter is multiplied by the decimal multiplier in calculatePrice.
decimals parameter determines the multiplier exponent.
10 ** decimals is evaluated before the price division inside calculatePrice.
Operand a feeds the unchecked multiply operation in times.
Operand b feeds the unchecked multiply operation in times.
The multiplication product is stored in local variable c and later returned.
value.times(multiplier) invokes the SafeMathLibExt library from calculatePrice.
Raw division a / b is executed inside SafeMathLibExt.divides.
Raw subtraction a - b is executed inside SafeMathLibExt.minus.
Raw addition a + b is executed inside SafeMathLibExt.plus.
Parameter a is consumed by the times function.
Parameter b is consumed by the times function.
crowdsale parameter is accepted by isSane for configuration validation.
purchaser parameter is accepted by isPresalePurchase.
newOneTokenInWei parameter is accepted by the updateRate interface function.
weiRaised parameter is used in the calculatePrice interface.
tokensSold parameter is used in the calculatePrice interface.
msgSender parameter is used in the calculatePrice interface.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter whose only dataflow sink is the transferOwnership function that writes it to owner.
crowdsale is a parameter consumed solely by the isSane validation function.
purchaser is a parameter used only inside isPresalePurchase.
newOneTokenInWei is the sole parameter of the updateRate interface function.
value is a parameter of the calculatePrice interface function.
weiRaised is a parameter of the calculatePrice interface function.
tokensSold is a parameter of the calculatePrice interface function.
msgSender is a parameter of the calculatePrice interface function.
decimals is a parameter of the calculatePrice interface function.
a is an operand that flows directly into the raw multiplication unsafe operation.
b is an operand that flows directly into the raw multiplication unsafe operation.
c is a local variable holding the result produced inside the times function.
_tier is a parameter written to the tier state variable by setTier.
_oneTokenInWei is a constructor parameter stored into oneTokenInWei.
newOneTokenInWei is a parameter written to oneTokenInWei by updateRate.
